name: Camp Ruggles
description_short: Camp Ruggles has run a therapeutic summer program for Rhode Island children for more than 50 years. It combines highly structured therapeutic support with summer camp experiences such as friendships, swimming, boating, fishing and creative activities.
special_needs_notes: The camp calls itself a "therapeutic summer experience." This page does not say which needs or conditions it serves.
